defs.def: to help sth to happen or develop 促进；推动

ex.s: To promote green transportation.
ex.t: 为了推广绿色交通。

ex.s: Interdisciplinary approach promotes creativity.
ex.t: 跨学科方法促进创新。

ex.s: Community Services: support communities by providing upcycled goods to those in need and help promote projects through social platforms to widen outreach.
ex.t: 社区服务：通过向有需要的人提供升级改造的物品来支持社区，并通过社交平台帮助推广项目以扩大影响范围。

ex.s: set up social platformsD. promote language learning
ex.t: 建立社交平台。D.促进语言学习。

ex.s: Promote cultural diversity.
ex.t: 做选择是生活的一部分。

ex.s: To promote the local culture.
ex.t: 为了推广当地文化。

ex.s: If most of their customers are happy to buy larger quantities, that’s   59   they’ll promote.
ex.t: 如果他们的大多数客户都乐意购买更大数量，那就是他们会推广的__59__。

ex.s: Promoting the use of a digital device.
ex.t: 推广数字设备的使用。

ex.s: Promote the use of solar energy in rural areas.
ex.t: 促进太阳能在农村地区的使用。

ex.s: meet people from different backgroundsD. promote the IOC Young Leaders project

ex.s: To promote the elderly people’s welfare.
ex.t: 促进老年人的福利。

ex.s: To promote eco-tourism.
ex.t: 促进生态旅游。

ex.s: Markman also promotes off-task time.
ex.t: Markman还提倡非工作时间。

ex.s: To promote a new technology.
ex.t: 为了推广一项新技术。

ex.s: Which level of background noise may promote creative thinking ability?
ex.t: 哪个水平的背景噪音可能促进创造性思维能力？

ex.s: In addition to 31    skills, Pruitt's lessons teach teamwork, encourage self-worth, and promote feelings of community.
ex.t: 除了   31    技能之外普鲁特的课程还教授团队合作鼓励自我价值感并促进社区意识。

ex.s: To promote guilt-free fur.
ex.t: 推广无内疚感毛皮。

ex.s: Experience helps to promote excellence.
ex.t: 有坚强意志的人可以实现目标。

ex.s: Promote good deeds.
ex.t: 促进善行。

ex.s: To promote kindness and sympathy.
ex.t: 为了提倡善意与同情。

ex.s: All our projects aim to promote the development of poor and remote communities.
ex.t: 你有机会结识可能成为终身朋友的新人。

ex.s: To promote values of the Victorian age.
ex.t: 史蒂文·斯坦喜欢跟着垃圾车跑。

ex.s: The organizations were established in the 1930s by Westerners in China to promote industrial and economic development.
ex.t: 这些组织是20世纪30年代由在华西方人建立的，旨在促进工业和经济发展。

ex.s: The governments argue that this will help foreigners better join the society and promote understanding across cultures.
ex.t: 政府辩称，这将帮助外国人更好地融入社会，并促进跨文化的理解。

ex.s: To promote the idea of recycling     B.
ex.t: 为了推广回收的理念     B.

ex.s: You’ll also be asked to promote the islands through newspapers, magazines and TV interviews.
ex.t: 透过报纸、杂志及电视采访,

ex.s: UNESCO - the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation - maintains a list of sites of outstanding natural importance, so as to protect, conserve and promote awareness of them.
ex.t: 联合国教科文组织——联合国教育、科学及文化组织——维护着一个具有突出自然重要性的地点名录，以保护、保存和提高人们对它们的认识。

ex.s: Given that the theme of the Expo was to promote cultural exchange and strengthen mutual cooperation between the countries along the Silk Road, Dunhuang was the ideal place.
ex.t: 鉴于世博会的主题是促进文化交流和加强丝绸之路沿线国家之间的相互合作，敦煌是理想之地。

ex.s: Doing sports promotes friendship.
ex.t: 运动促进友谊

defs.def: to help sell a product, service, etc. or make it more popular by advertising it or offering it at a special price 促销；推销

ex.s: “We are going to make a change, ”she said.“I’ve started a project to promote the teaching of the arts in our schools.”
ex.t: 这个项目的起因是许多学校难以邀请各类艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐家还是著名电影明星——来学校和孩子们交流并激励他们。

defs.def: to move sb to a higher rank or more senior job 提升；晋升

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

ex.s: to be promoted B. being promoted
ex.t: 被提升B. 被提升

ex.s: promoting D. to promote
ex.t: 提升D. 去提升

ex.s: Hunters bring in more than 300,000 nutria tails a year, so part of Mouton’s job these days is trying to promote fur.
ex.t: 猎人每年带回超过30万条海狸鼠的尾巴，所以穆顿如今工作的一部分就是试图推广毛皮。

defs.def: to move a sports team from playing with one group of teams to playing in a better group 将（体育运动队）晋级

ex.s: This role would enable me to help bring our history to life for visitors and promote local culture.
ex.t: 这个角色将使我能够帮助为游客再现我们的历史，并推广当地文化。

ex.s: They promote the Olympic values, spreading the message of sport for good.
ex.t: 他们推广奥林匹克价值观，传播"体育向善"的信息。

ex.s: Why does storytelling work better than mere statement of facts in promoting learning?
ex.t: 为什么在促进学习方面，讲故事比仅仅陈述事实更有效？
